operations.description: Returns the values for each date from a given time range and optionally the sub entity type, where applicable, that are associated with the specific daily metrics. Example request: `GET https://businessprofileperformance.googleapis.com/v1/locations/12345:fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries?dailyMetrics=WEBSITE_CLICKS&dailyMetrics=CALL_CLICKS&daily_range.start_date.year=2022&daily_range.start_date.month=1&daily_range.start_date.day=1&daily_range.end_date.year=2022&daily_range.end_date.month=3&daily_range.end_date.day=31`

operations.description: Returns the search keywords used to find a business in search or maps. Each search keyword is accompanied by impressions which are aggregated on a monthly basis. Example request: `GET https://businessprofileperformance.googleapis.com/v1/locations/12345/searchkeywords/impressions/monthly?monthly_range.start_month.year=2022&monthly_range.start_month.month=1&monthly_range.end_month.year=2022&monthly_range.end_month.month=3`
